review_markdown.description: The sticky review comment, verbatim. Must carry <!-- score: N --> and the full head SHA.

findings.description: Inline comments, one per changed line worth commenting on.

path.description: Repo-relative path, exactly as it appears in files.txt.

line.description: Line in the new file, or in the old file when side is LEFT.

start_line.description: First line of a multi-line comment; must be <= line.

side.description: RIGHT (the default) is the new file, LEFT the old one.

severity.description: P0 blocks the merge, P1 should be fixed, P2 is optional.
